ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

option.description: Option and Option Group are primitives for selectable lists controlled by parent components like Select, Multi Select, and Autocomplete.

examples.note: Standalone list items with label and description. Selection is controlled by the parent component.

group.note: Option Group labels a set of options with role="group" and propagates disabled to every child option.

indicators.note: The selection indicator is opt-in. Without it, a selected option keeps its selected state but renders no checkmark or checkbox.

installation.note: Install the Solaris UI package and import the option and option group components.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

selection-modes.note: Selection mode is visual only: the parent component owns toggling and values. None hides selection semantics, single shows a checkmark, multiple shows a checkbox-like indicator.

size-density.note: Size and density adjust font and padding only. Option carries no control height: it sizes to its content inside the parent list.

slots.note: Leading, label, description, meta, and trailing slots compose rich rows without dedicated icon or badge inputs.

states.note: Disabled options render with reduced opacity, expose aria-disabled, and ignore pointer interaction.

option.title: Option
